scope: Read-only pre-market F detector, test suites, study runner, report builder and preregistered plan audit. Only synthetic input used. No real F market detection, preparation or scoring performed.
single_intervention: The immutable original V3 candidate at t becomes a public F acceptance only at complete contiguous t+1 close strictly above its frozen prior12 high. Original candidate raw edges, accepted-candidate 12-bar cooldown and original child ages0..3 remain unchanged. No additional quality gate is introduced.

resolved_pre_market_issue.finding: The initial draft's raw public-label-drop gate would have allowed unknown missing-next-bar candidates to improve the noise-reduction gate.
resolved_pre_market_issue.resolution: Before any F market run the plan and code were changed to require both the raw<=6021 and raw drop>=50% gate and conservative public labels + unknown_original_labels<=6021 with drop>=50% relative to the unchanged 12042 denominator. Other acceptance gates remain unchanged.

tests.root_total_composition: 53 F + 17 original V3 Python + 24 Pine tests, parent-reported; this reviewer independently ran the 53 F tests, not all 94.

independent_synthetic_state_oracle.method: Injected immutable synthetic original V3 streams and independently enumerated each candidate's per-prefix disposition, original-child clock and public event clocks. All source columns, full-state prefixes and future mutations checked; no original V3 detector helper used in the reference calculation.
independent_synthetic_state_oracle.coverage: Strict above/equal/below, lower close than discovery while still above boundary, gaps, invalid/absent OHLC, no ATR/volume/ready gate, child ages0..3, rejected and unknown child nonrevival, sample-end pending and separate final registry.

independent_core_pipeline_smoke.full_evaluate_CLI_not_run: Production full-pool guard was intentionally not bypassed for this tiny synthetic pool
independent_core_pipeline_smoke.method: Used two temporary synthetic feature files and injected original V3 streams. Ran actual prepare, candidate registry, common random controls, initialize_evaluation, score_job, unchanged simulate_trade, matching, clock/retention/trade summaries and assessment. Temporary inputs and outputs were deleted automatically. No repository result path was used.
independent_core_pipeline_smoke.boundary: The production evaluate CLI's fixed10386/3809/1463/488 real-pool guard was not bypassed or forged. This is a core prepare-to-score-to-summary smoke, not a real complete-market evaluation.
independent_core_pipeline_smoke.cache_test: An exact acceptance-index cache record was reused; the raw discovery-index event was still simulated separately. Acceptance t+1 and discovery t never shared the wrong cache identity.

frozen_acceptance.conservative_count: F distinct public labels + unknown candidate original distinct labels

pre_market_receipt_guard.implementation: study.source_pins includes this actual file and requires exact bytes equal git HEAD before prepare; evaluate verifies unchanged source pins. This JSON does not contain its own SHA.
pre_market_receipt_guard.current_status: Written before any F real-market results/started.json exists. Parent must commit exact receipt and sources and independently verify HEAD byte equality before prepare. This receipt does not claim that the subsequent commit already happened.
pre_market_receipt_guard.immutability: Do not edit this receipt after it is committed for prepare. Any actual artifact review or later deviation belongs in qa/independent_review.json.

observations: Waiting one candle can reduce label count through early-child merging even without rejecting a parent. These are explicitly decomposed and not called removed losing trades.
The public fresh-signal clock remains strict: a discovery already one bar late becomes a two-bar-late acceptance and is counted as a miss under the unchanged timely metric.
Per-bar state and final registry serve different purposes: a final missing-next-bar is pending in the historical causal state and unknown only in the clearly marked final registry.

Original parent_i intentionally refers to discovery; economic_parent_i and acceptance_i refer to the later public event. Reusing previous studies' parent_i=public early-index assumption would be incorrect here.
Known rejection only means the next valid close is not above the frozen boundary. It does not establish that the candidate would have lost money later.
All 53 tests, separate random clock oracle and two-asset core pipeline smoke passed. None establishes F market performance or deployability.
limitations: Sixth sequential structural hypothesis on already inspected historical data; local Holm6 does not establish blind OOS or fully correct earlier13 explorations.
Only fixed278 historical OKX1H long-side markets excluding BTC/ETH are planned. Cross-venue, other-timeframe and future-universe validity is unproven.
Complete valid OHLC is a data-quality condition. Missing volume/ATR/ready is not a new acceptance veto; downstream invalid execution inputs remain governed by the unchanged executor.
Frozen20bp event costs omit funding, spreads and impact. Event trades overlap and are not accountNAV or portfolio drawdown.
Original V1 keeps authenticated historical controls and cannot be presented as a new common V3/F randomized comparison.
The synthetic pipeline covered actual prepare, score and summaries, but intentionally did not bypass the production evaluate CLI's fixed real-pool guard.
Report builder was read for clock/accounting claims; no F report or nativePine rendering was performed, and no live-monitor deployment/parity was audited.
Only this new receipt is written in the repository. Source, tests, plan, registries, existing results and other workers' files remain untouched.
